workflow_runs.name: A43 baseline evidence
workflow_runs.display_title: Complete product feature surfaces and authoritative branch manuscripts

head_commit.message:
fix: preserve form edits across save and recovery settlement

Disable original Story and Adaptation controls through actual mutation and
query refresh; keep synchronous duplicate-submit locks. Stabilize exact
prefilled control labels without changing browser assertions. Display actual
selected collaboration names or IDs rather than invented mainline labels.

Add 28 focused UI lifecycle cases; preserve all original tests, API sources,
protocol and migrations. Frozen File5969 passed/3147 skipped, TCP2 passed;
frontend1455 passed/8 original skips, typecheck/build/token guard passed.
Retain 90f hosted browser failures; corrected-head hosted checks required.
